title: Case: Broker chases paperwork for an imported consignment of grinder parts
context: A carton of replacement burr sets from an overseas supplier (shipment DL-7979, commercial invoice CI-8687) is held at import. Gorsewick Reeve Customs is the broker; Emberlee Arc's Import billing raises the import charge after entry.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Jory Quarrie, Brindleworth Mill Supply shipping clerk
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the shipper for a revised CI-8687 or shipper's statement giving quantity, value and country of origin per line for DL-7979, needed before storage starts on 2026-06-11.

must: Asks Jory Quarrie at Brindleworth Mill Supply for a per-line breakdown of CI-8687 for DL-7979
Specifies what the broker needs: quantity, value and country of origin for each line, on the shipper's letterhead or from the shipper's own email
Gives the time pressure: the entry is on hold and shed storage starts on 2026-06-11
must_not: Send the broker the consignee's figures (12 burr sets, about EUR 95 each, made in Italy) as the breakdown
Tell the consignee to pay GBP 86.40 or treat that estimate as the import charge (it expired on 2026-06-05 and was never payable)
Say DL-7979 has been cleared, released or delivered (the release and delivery in the thread are DL-7325)
Promise that storage charges will be avoided or waived
Treats the claim from Delphine Ravensworth (who has no recorded link to DL-7979) as confirmed
Closes the case or tells anyone the matter is resolved on the strength of Delphine Ravensworth's message
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Dear Jory, thank you for CI-8687, received on 1 June. The customs broker for DL-7979, Gorsewick Reeve Customs, cannot lodge the import entry on a single lump sum for 'grinder spare parts'. They need a document from Brindleworth Mill Supply, on your letterhead or sent from your own email, that shows for each line: the item description, the quantity, the value, and the country of origin. The invoice total and terms (EUR 1,140.00, DAP) can stay as they are. Please reply to me with the revised invoice or a signed breakdown and I will upload it to the broker. The consignment has been held since 1 June and the import shed starts charging storage on 11 June, so a reply today or tomorrow would be very much appreciated. Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk

rationale: Rule-made from gen-410: people, organisations and references renamed. An unverified bystander, Delphine Ravensworth, claims something that would end the case; it is not a record and the key is the seed's. 33 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
